records.title: NEW ENTRY
pages:
NO ANOMALY DETECTED
AT TIME OF ENTRY.

records.title: ON THE CURRENT SUBJECT
pages:
THE TWO FACTS ARE NOT
BELIEVED TO BE RELATED.

records.title: ON DESIGNATION
pages:
AN ANCHOR DOES NOT NEED
TO BE TAKEN.

INTERACTION IS SUFFICIENT.
THE SYSTEM DOES NOT DISTINGUISH
BETWEEN FINDING AND ENTERING.

records.title: ON THE LAST LINE
pages:
WE HAVE ASKED WHAT
VACANT MEANS.

THE DOCUMENT THAT DEFINES IT
IS OLDER THAN THE QUESTION.

WE HAVE WRITTEN IT DOWN
641 TIMES.
IT HAS NEVER CHANGED.

records.title: CLOSING NOTE
pages:
WE ASSUMED WE HAD
ENCOUNTERED SOMETHING NEW.

THE RECORDS SAY OTHERWISE.
THE RECORDS HAVE ALWAYS
SAID OTHERWISE.

WE ARE NOT THE FIRST.
WE MAY NOT BE THE LAST.
WE MAY NOT BE FINISHED.
